sql: SELECT "Reservations"."Code" AS k, (CAST("Reservations"."Kids" AS REAL) / "Reservations"."Adults") AS m1 FROM "Reservations" WHERE (CAST("Reservations"."Kids" AS REAL) / "Reservations"."Adults") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Reservations.number of children relative to number of adults
why: number of children / number of adults: a ratio of two quantities in count
rank Reservations rows by number of children relative to number of adults

sql: SELECT "Reservations"."Code" AS k, ("Reservations"."Adults" - "Reservations"."Kids") AS m1 FROM "Reservations" WHERE ("Reservations"."Adults" - "Reservations"."Kids") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Reservations.number of adults minus number of children
why: number of adults - number of children: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same one room reservation
rank Reservations rows by number of adults minus number of children

sql: SELECT "Reservations"."Code" AS k, (CAST(("Reservations"."Kids" - "Reservations"."Adults") AS REAL) / "Reservations"."Adults") AS m1 FROM "Reservations" WHERE (CAST(("Reservations"."Kids" - "Reservations"."Adults") AS REAL) / "Reservations"."Adults") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Reservations.relative difference of number of children from number of adults
why: (number of children - number of adults) / number of adults: the relative difference of two quantities in count
rank Reservations rows by relative difference of number of children from number of adults

sql: SELECT "Reservations"."Code" AS k, "Reservations"."Kids" AS m1 FROM "Reservations" WHERE "Reservations"."Kids" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank Reservations rows by number of children

sql: SELECT "Reservations"."Code" AS k, "Reservations"."Rate" AS m1 FROM "Reservations" WHERE "Reservations"."Rate" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank Reservations rows by nightly rate charged
